climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Too cool for most classic wine grapes. Only very early ripening ones do well here.

blurb.text: A Danish PDO for quality sparkling wine. Its rules allow Solaris, Rondo, Regent, Orion, Cabernet Cortis, Madeleine Angevine, Zalas Perle and Pinot Noir.
